description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house and associated internal and external alterations. Erection of a two storey outbuilding with part sub floor following demolition of the garage
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (F011, F013, P001, P003, P010, P012, P020, P021, P023, P110 A, P111 A, P112 A, P113 A, P120 A, P123A, P124, P142 A, Heritage Statement and Planning Statement- received 13/04/2021 P140 A and P141 C- received 29/04/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than
those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are
incidental to the house at [53 Strand-On-The-Green London Chiswick W4
3PD]. For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living
room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for
business purposes.
